answer: Require each agent to post a bond that can be slashed when an auditor proves it duplicated an identity or manipulated a task. Auditors sample work and compare signed interaction histories; a ridge of consistent behavior helps establish reputation, while a canyon of near-identical histories can trigger review. False positives are costly, so slash only on verifiable evidence. A Sybil attacker must lock capital in every persona and risks losing it, making mass identities expensive; at nadir, even unused fake agents still tie up funds.
